featured_reviews.name: kanak ayare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely shocking experience at Westside Ghatkopar. This isn’t just bad service—it’s outright customer manipulation.

The staff? Completely clueless and borderline dismissive. You ask a simple question and get blank stares or vague answers like they’d rather be anywhere else.

Now the real issue—their ‘Go Green’ option on the website. It’s quietly pre-selected without clearly informing you, and the moment you proceed, you’re locked into a trap. No proper exchanges, no flexibility—just forced store credit. And guess what? That credit expires in 6 months. Use it or lose it. Convenient for them, not for customers.

This isn’t sustainability, it’s disguised policy engineering.

If you’re charging premium prices, at least have the decency to be transparent. Don’t sneak in options that limit customer rights.

Honestly, after this, I’d rather spend my money at Zara, Mango or H&M—at least they respect their customers enough to be upfront.

Westside—fix your policies or stop pretending to be customer-friendly.
